coverage_notes: The BP2V2 panel and Panasonic projector are optional visual-system examples because video/projection is outside the confirmed core scope.
The Global Truss section and Manfrotto stand illustrate physical support categories. A truss or stand model is not an engineering load model.
ColorSource 20 typical dimensions (465 W x 279 D x 60 H mm) verified in the ETC Spec Sheet rev G mirrored by distributor; physical DWG retained but not parsed.
The Manfrotto 1.25 m tripod spread is a secondary-source circular footprint envelope, not rectangular W/D; treat the overall bound as estimated.
Control paths distinguish control data, video signals, mains power, and passive mechanical connections; no DMX personalities are invented for products that are not DMX fixtures.

Second-pass documented candidates include a DMX splitter, pixel-data controller, optional LED video processor and optional adjustable stage deck. Projection-screen and followspot camera/system hardware remain unfilled because no exact model passed the direct-image plus dimension evidence bar in this pass.

Da-Lite screen sample uses exact SKU 88692 frame/viewing-area dimensions from its product page and manufacturer series spec sheet; the attached-leg footprint is only dimensioned in a family illustration, and no separate direct raster URL for that exact SKU was found.

Drapes/soft goods, stairs and custom scenic pieces should be authored as parametric production-specific objects (width, height, fullness, trim, stair rise/run and profile), not treated as universally fixed exact-product models.

A power-distro exact candidate was not added: ETC Sensor3 portable-pack physical drawing is DWG and was not dimension-extracted, while candidate secondary listings did not establish exact dimensions/image provenance for a same SKU. No exact manufacturer-dimensioned cable/terminator or mains adapter candidate with exact geometry and visual source passed this pass; represent cable runs by specified length plus estimated coil/straight form, and adapters as parametric connector forms pending verified references.
The Lodestar D8+ entry is an optional rigging-hardware visual reference, not a certified hoist/rigging design; chain, chain bag, controller, lift, and clearance are instance/configuration parameters.
